review.content_class_rationale: A Word document of Supplemental Digital Content 1 to 10: the PubMed search string, a table of 20 contributing publications, a country-of-origin count table, group-level characteristic tables by income group and for a sensitivity analysis, a forest-plot picture and a native Word age-band chart with an embedded workbook. It mixes methods, literature and aggregate registry tables, so no narrower class fits.
review.notes: All 284 extracted text units and the one embedded image were read in the supplement document review. Every table reports group statistics (n (%) or median (IQR)) for the 231 nosocomial and 931 community-acquired registry deaths or lists publications; no individual patient is described.
limitations: Some extracted units are marked non-literal by the extractor and are not quotable.

The age-band chart is a native Word chart that was not rendered as pixels; its embedded workbook (word/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel-werkblad.xlsx; sheets "3A", "3B", "leeftijdsverdeling health+comor") is aggregate only, has group sizes 28/76/120 (total 224) that differ from the article, and lies outside the extraction inventory.
The embedded forest-plot image prints no numeric values, so nothing was transcribed from it.

review.content_class_rationale: An 8-page PDF headed with the article title that lists the RSV GOLD study group collaborators by name and their numbered institutional affiliations. It is an author and contributor listing, not a checklist, protocol, literature table or clinical data.
review.notes: All 8 rendered pages were viewed; administrative author and affiliation lists only, with no patient or clinical content.
limitations: Personal names and affiliations are not transcribed.
Both files were opened and read in full (284 text units and one embedded image of the Word document; 8 rendered PDF pages).
Registry-level tables are group statistics and are not assigned to any patient.
